It's a `Carrier_Dwell_Summary` export dropping timestamps at Dock Door 9, filed by a warehouse supervisor at "the account Nadia runs". - **Not visible to me:** I couldn't see any account ticket files, such as an `accounts/.../tickets` folder, from your access. This list comes only from the pod channel, the Hartford room and Moss's digests, so the ticketing system itself may have more.
